name: TES Sostanj (Sostanj Thermal Power Plant) data center
developer: Termoelektrarna Sostanj d.o.o. (TES); Advant d.o.o. (data-center/network contractor)
notes: Advant's public reference portfolio lists TES, Termoelektrarna Sostanj / Sostanj Thermal Power Plant, for construction of a new approximately 120 m2 data center with redundant APC 2 x 160 kVA UPS (about 8 racks; 160 kVA per UPS). Carried over from first-round codex discovery (results/batch-57x) and re-graded B per SI methodology (engineering-contractor customer case study). Treated as operational because it appears in completed reference portfolios. No public IT MW capacity found (capacity null; 2x160 kVA UPS rating noted instead). Attempted direct browse of advant.si/reference on 2026-08-12 failed (JS-rendered page, no static text); general web search found no separate TES data-center news.

name: MegaTel / MEGA M data center (colocation)
notes: MegaTel official page (browsed 2026-08-12) describes an active colocation data-center service: rack/telecom-cabinet and full server-room rental, redundant dual-feed A/B power with UPS and generator backup, 99.99% power availability, redundant cooling with hot/cold aisles, Novec-1230 fire suppression, 24/7 access control, and direct SIX (Slovenian Internet eXchange) interconnect. Datacenters.com directory lists the MEGA M d.o.o. colocation location at Rudarska cesta 6, 3320 Velenje (address is directory-supported, grade C); DataCenterMap confirms MEGA M as a data-center services provider headquartered in Velenje. Operator page is A for service/facility existence; combined evidence grade B. No public MW capacity found; also reuses first-round lead.
